verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is primarily a law firm, but it ships Visalaw AI, a software product with a UI, so asking about API parity is a fair question. The evidence shows no public API at all: the marketing pages describe only UI-driven drafting, research and document workflows. Probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the visalaw.com candidate paths all returned 404, and llms.txt also returned 404.
